hypothesis: The observed counts suggest approximately linear steady-state work with additional overhead concentrated in the smallest prefill batches. These entry-state indicators test that distinction; they do not establish whether the excess comes from initialization or batch shape.

pcvs.name: num_requests
pcvs.rationale: Models per-request bookkeeping and metadata work.

pcvs.name: num_scheduled_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Models token-sized array operations and copies.

pcvs.name: single_request_prefill
pcvs.rationale: Separates the single-request prefill state, which exhibited substantially higher instruction count.

pcvs.name: two_request_prefill
pcvs.rationale: Separates the smaller excess observed for two-request prefill from ordinary token-dependent work.
